title: Nuanced Pragmatic Particles of Irony
goal: I can make a remark ironic with *elvégre* and *netalán*.
I can tell a literal statement from polite mockery in Hungarian.
I can decode implied social criticism masked as polite agreement.

sections.title: Unit 5: Irony, Understatement & Sarcastic Register Shifting
body: In Central European culture, irony is not a trivial joke; it is a philosophy of existence and an intellectual armor against absurdity, tyranny, and catastrophe.
In this unit, inspired by the grotesque prose of István Örkény, you will practise the irony particles *elvégre* and *netalán*, understatement, polite disclaimers and parody.

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can make a remark ironic with *elvégre* and *netalán*.
I can tell a literal statement from polite mockery in Hungarian.
I can decode implied social criticism masked as polite agreement.
